changes.comment: The Publish page can show what a pending change does, as a before/after comparison rather than a diff: each changed field is one row with the stored value beside the staged one, worded by the field type — Yes/No for booleans, option labels for selects, file names for media, breadcrumbs into sections. The server gained `GET /api/admin/changes/compare`, which reads the same document from the repository and from the pending workspace — HEAD versus the working tree locally, the repository versus the draft overlay when deployed.
